name: SnoCo Veterans Day Weekend 2023
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransDayWeekend2023#21634-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Even though we don't expect this to be an issue, please be aware that depending on the amount of competitors, we might need to change the amount of rounds or amount of competitors that can procceed to future rounds. This is in compliance to regulations [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m) and [9p](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p) If the events that you are competing in are on only one day of the competition, you are still welcome, but not required to attend both days of the competition. We might run ahead of schedule throughout the competition. Please be present up to 30 minutes before any event that you are scheduled to compete in.
